stem: How did the creation of NASA influence the U.S. economy during the 1960s?

options.label: A
options.text: Government investment in scientific research and development led to the establishment of new industries.

options.label: B
options.text: Government concern over satellite launches led to calls for the expansion of the military draft.

options.label: C
options.text: Government interest in space exploration resulted in reduced federal tax rates.

options.label: D
options.text: Government control over information and technology sectors resulted in decreased corporate competition.
